meta.title: ECNU open data
meta.description: Read ECNU personnel, student and staff data from the university open-data platform.
meta.detail: Adds read-only tools for the East China Normal University open-data gateway: personnel lookup, student and staff profiles, photos, positions and an allowlisted query tool. Institutional reads use the platform client credentials; data about the signed-in person uses the university SSO login. Sensitive, facial-recognition, verification and message-sending endpoints are never exposed.
